notes: Product-family vendor read on daysmart.com/vet pages as instructed: product home, pricing, about DaySmart Vet, integrations, Daisy AI, PetCare app, and the cited demo page; all HTTP 200 and not thin. The pricing page publishes 'Plans starting at $123/month', so the many '$116 per month' claims (C02) are classed wrong; no dated price change is documented on the pages read, so they are not stale. C02 is traced to a cited CoVet comparison article (read once under the ezyVet vendor, snapshot reused). One Google AI Mode line, 'often starting around $110–$120/month', was not coded because the price is hedged ('often'); while checking it, its cited pages were looked at (the digitail.com home, read under the Digitail vendor, and the DaySmart demo page carry no such range; the cited Capterra directory answered HTTP 403). C10: the pricing page says 'Since 2011' while the about page dates Vetter's founding to 2010; the claim ('around since 2011') matches the former. C06 and C05 split one answer line into 'no hidden fees' (true) and 'no per-user fees' (unverifiable). Support hours, report counts, ratings and ease-of-use lines were not coded. The vague pricing cell 'Lower-end (contact)' was not coded. Pass 2 (8 Oct 2026): no browser snapshot exists for DaySmart Vet and no claim was unverifiable because of a blocked own page, so nothing was re-classed. Consistency check: C02 stays wrong (explicit starting price on the vendor's own pricing page, same basis). Completeness: every gap line and table cell about DaySmart Vet was either already an instance (the ~$116 and From $116 cells, the cloud and IDEXX cells) or out of scope (best-for, budget positioning, ratings, generic integrations, the hedged 'don't want to pay $250+ per month' comparison, support lines); the $289 line in q6 Google AI Overviews run 2 is about another vendor. No claims or instances were added.
